components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Polished chrome pill button with dark text. Used for CTAs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #C4CCD4; color: #0A0A0A; padding: 14px 28px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E0E6EC; transform: scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(196,204,212,0.15); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4CCD4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost button with border. Used for secondary actions on dark backgrounds.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 14px 28px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.2); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4CCD4; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dark Card
components.description: Surface dark card with border and ambient shadow. Used on dark sections.
components.css: .ds-card-dark { background: #111111; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); } .ds-card-dark h3 { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card-dark p { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; color: #A3A3A3; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Email Input
components.description: Email input field for the footer contact form.
components.css: .ds-input-email { background: #111111; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid #262626; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.3s; } .ds-input-email::placeholder { color: #666666; } .ds-input-email:focus { border-color: #C4CCD4; }

narrative.overview:
This is a cinematic scroll-driven experience — full-bleed imagery, scroll-scrubbed frame sequences, and dramatic transitions between sections. The silver accent is the light source: it catches the eye the way chrome catches a spotlight in a dark showroom. Every section is a frame in the reel; the scroll is the playback.

The system alternates between darkness and light. Dark sections carry the cinematic weight — immersive, full-bleed, dramatic. Light sections provide visual relief and showcase clarity. The transitions between them are deliberate cuts, not fades.

The polished chrome silver is the one consistent character across all sections. It appears on CTA buttons, accent text, the 'RS' lettering in the hero, icons, and divider details. Its rarity is its power.
keyCharacteristics: Scroll as playback — every section is a frame in the cinematic reel
Polished chrome silver as the single accent — cool, reflective, rare
Alternating dark/light rhythm — dramatic immersion vs. clear relief
Ambient shadows always on — cards and images carry depth at all times
Full-bleed imagery — photographs fill their containers edge to edge
Section dividers as film splices — 1px lines between scenes, not gradients

rules.name: The One Light Source Rule
rules.body: Polished Chrome is the only accent color in the system. It never shares the screen with another saturated hue.

rules.name: The 10% Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Polished Chrome never covers more than 10% of any visible viewport. It punctuates; it never fills.

rules.name: The Non-White Vacuum Rule
rules.body: Any non-white empty area on a dark section should use Pure Black (#000000), not a gray.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Tiny uppercase tracked labels must NOT appear above every section heading. This is the saturated AI scaffold.

rules.name: The Weight Contrast Rule
rules.body: Display headings are 700. Body is 400. Body-light is 300. The contrast is the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Always-On Rule
rules.body: Shadows are not hover decorations. Cards and images carry ambient shadows at rest.

rules.name: The Dark Section Deepening Rule
rules.body: Shadows on dark sections must be deeper (0.4+ alpha) than shadows on light sections (0.15 alpha).

dos: Do use Polished Chrome (#C4CCD4) as the single accent color for buttons, 'RS' lettering, icon highlights, and interactive element borders.
Do use full pill (9999px) radius on all buttons — no exceptions.
Do carry ambient shadows on cards and images at all times — depth is always on.
Do alternate dark and light sections for cinematic rhythm.
Do use 1px dividers between sections as film splices.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce for all scroll animations and parallax.
donts: Don't use tiny uppercase tracked labels above every section heading. Banned AI scaffold.
Don't use gradient text. Use a single solid color.
Don't use numbered section markers (01, 02, 03) as scaffolding.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as colored accent).
Don't let Polished Chrome exceed 10% of any visible viewport.
Don't use generic AI-generated look: cream/sand backgrounds, flat card grids, templated layouts.
Don't use gray text on a colored background — use a darker shade of the background's hue.
